documents.document: The service abri uses azurite for transport and beryl as its audit label. The service cevu uses coral for transport and flint as its audit label.
The audit label of enko is mica; enko uses lapis for transport. For dofi, transport is jasper and the audit label is kaolin.
For falu, opal is the audit label and ochre is the transport setting. The service gemi uses pearl for transport; its audit label is ruby.
The transport setting for itva is stibnite and its audit label is gesso. The service horo has audit label zinc and uses talc for transport.
